meta.purpose: Content source for the public marketing page: features, why-choose-us, and competitor comparison for Certificate Generator.

time_saved.label: saved per graduating class or cohort
time_saved.detail: Manually designing, generating, and emailing a few hundred certificates in a graphics tool and mail client is an afternoon-eating chore, repeated every cohort. Auto-issuance from your LMS plus one-click bulk send turns that into a background job you never touch.

how_it_works.headline: From Canva design to finished PDF in four steps

steps.title: Design your certificate anywhere
steps.detail: Build the background in Canva (or any design tool) and leave the name area blank. Export it as an image.

steps.title: Create the template and place fields
steps.detail: Upload the background, then drag Student Name, School, Date and custom fields onto the canvas. Coordinates update in real time.

steps.title: Upload your brand font (Pro)
steps.detail: Add any .ttf (a script font for names, for example) and select it for any field on the template. The free plugin ships 27 built-in fonts.

steps.title: Preview with debug mode
steps.detail: Click Preview to get a sample PDF with field boundaries and position markers drawn on it, so you can line everything up before issuing.

hero.headline: Certificates, badges, and verification — without leaving WordPress
hero.subheadline: Free and unlimited: design once, bulk-issue from CSV, email and let anyone verify in one click. Add Pro to auto-issue from your LMS or WooCommerce store. No external PDF service, no per-certificate fees.

features.title: Drag-and-drop certificate designer
features.pitch: Upload any background image and position every field exactly where you want it — no CSS, no design tool, no exporting from Canva.
features.detail: Per-field fonts, sizes and colours, custom-text fields with {field} tags, image and e-signature fields, 27 built-in fonts. The QR code and serial number are fields too: drag them into place and style the serial like any other text. Preview with a real record before you issue — and issued certificates keep their layout even if you edit the template later.

features.title: Names in any language, rendered on your server
features.pitch: Certificates render in-house via a bundled PDF engine — nothing to install, nothing calling out to a third-party API.
features.detail: Latin names render instantly; Indian scripts, Urdu / Arabic, Cyrillic and other non-Latin names switch automatically to a bundled Unicode engine with the right fonts. No server setup, no rate-limited rendering service.

features.title: Built-in QR code verification
features.pitch: Every certificate is fraud-checkable the moment it's issued — automatically, with zero configuration.
features.detail: Each PDF embeds a QR code (generated on your own server) linking to a public verification page with a 12-character unguessable code. Recipients can share to LinkedIn, X or WhatsApp; revoked or reissued certificates show their real status.

features.title: Automatic issuance from your LMS or store (Pro)
features.pitch: Stop generating certificates by hand. Completion triggers the certificate.
features.detail: The Pro add-on works with Tutor LMS (course completion or a passed quiz), LearnDash, LifterLMS, Sensei (including tracks), LearnPress and WooCommerce order completion, guest orders included — and can issue certificates for everyone who completed before you installed it.

features.title: Bulk import, bulk send, bulk everything
features.pitch: Onboard a thousand students in one CSV upload, then email their certificates in a single click — free, with no row or email limits.
features.detail: An import check maps columns, detects delimiter and encoding and flags problems before anything is saved (sample CSVs included). A background queue handles delivery over wp_mail, SMTP, Sender.net or Mandrill with rate limits and retries, plus admin ZIP downloads of every certificate.

features.title: Background bulk jobs you can undo
features.pitch: Generate thousands of certificates in the background and fix a bad import in one click.
features.detail: Bulk generation runs 25 at a time with a progress page, a list of failed records with their reason and Retry failed — never a duplicate certificate or a new serial. Every CSV import is logged: flag matching rows for review, or undo an import and get back the fields it changed. A Diagnostics page and WP-CLI commands (generate, import, jobs, diagnostics) cover the rest.

features.title: School coordinators and a certificate register
features.pitch: Let each school's staff issue their own certificates, and keep one register of everything issued.
features.detail: The School Coordinator role sees and issues certificates for its own school only; templates, settings and revoke stay with admins. The certificate register lists every certificate with serial, verification code and status, and downloads as CSV or a printable PDF.

features.title: Shareable digital badges
features.pitch: Give recipients a LinkedIn-ready badge image alongside their certificate.
features.detail: Optional companion PNG badge generated per certificate, plus image-type fields for signatures and seals.

features.title: Delivery analytics that actually help
features.pitch: Know who got their certificate, who didn't, and why — without digging through server logs.
features.detail: Per-send delivery status, dashboard charts, breakdowns by certificate type and school, and expiration reports.

features.title: Self-serve lookup for students, teachers, and schools
features.pitch: Recipients find their own certificates — support tickets go down.
features.detail: Drop-in shortcodes for student, teacher and school search plus a My Certificates page let recipients find and download their own certificates, with LinkedIn sharing on results.

features.title: REST API and webhooks (Pro)
features.pitch: Issue certificates from any system that can make an HTTP call — and hear back when things happen.
features.detail: certificate-generator/v1 with scoped API keys: create and update students (find or upsert by your own external_id), generate, download and revoke certificates, and run bulk jobs. Signed webhooks for 16 events (issued, verified, revoked, bulk job finished, import failed…) with retries. The free plugin keeps a public serial verification endpoint.

features.title: n8n, Zapier and WhatsApp automation (Pro)
features.pitch: Certificates go out without anyone touching them.
features.detail: The Automation page gives you five ready-made n8n workflow templates, a Zapier set-up guide and a one-click API key with the right scopes, plus job and webhook logs. Deliver certificates over WhatsApp as well as email.

features.title: Custom font upload (Pro)
features.pitch: Match your organization's brand exactly, down to the typeface.
features.detail: Upload a .ttf and it renders correctly via a dedicated font engine — selectable on any template.

why_choose_us.title: Nothing runs outside your site
why_choose_us.detail: PDF rendering, QR generation, and font embedding all happen on your own WordPress install. No per-certificate API fees, no third-party service that can go down or change its pricing.

why_choose_us.title: Verification is public and free, always
why_choose_us.detail: Anyone can verify a certificate's authenticity without an account, a paid plan, or contacting support — on every plan, including Free.

why_choose_us.title: Built for scale from the first CSV
why_choose_us.detail: Bulk import and bulk send use a background queue with retry logic, so sending to thousands of recipients doesn't mean a stuck browser tab or a bounced SMTP connection.

why_choose_us.title: Automation, not busywork
why_choose_us.detail: Connects directly to the LMS or store you already run (Pro add-on). A finished course or a completed order issues the certificate — nobody has to remember to do it manually.

why_choose_us.title: A genuinely free plugin, simple Pro pricing
why_choose_us.detail: The free plugin has no caps on certificates, emails, imports or templates, no license key and no account required. Pro is ₹249/month (₹2,499/year) for LMS and WooCommerce auto-issue, the REST API, webhooks, n8n / Zapier automation and custom fonts — not a quote-only enterprise wall.
